title: Precision, Maths and quantization
summary: Precision is policy, not an incidental Torch setting. Maths owns numerical domains, quantization state, proof outcome/strength and error claims; Audio owns which semantic tensor roles may lose precision.
invariants: Quantization is an execution representation change, not an acoustic enhancement.
Source PCM, alignment, TDOA, timestamps, provenance and Maths evidence are protected by default.
Math proof outcome and proof strength remain distinct.
A certified quantization error bound over represented values says nothing about information already lost by microphones, codecs, resampling or earlier processing.

provenance.claim: Maths v0.7 quantization, mixed precision and proof semantics used by Audio.
Audio precision policy and quantization evidence boundary.
